reasons.realCost: The real bill equals the $129 Lite sticker for a solo user but reaches $689/mo for a growing team, well above the $449 Advanced sticker, because each extra seat costs $80-$100 a month on top of the plan.
reasons.pricingHonesty: Every paid plan, its limits and most add-ons carry a published price, but pay-as-you-go rates for extra tracked keywords, export rows and crawl credits beyond a plan's limits are not published on any page Ahrefs makes public.
reasons.smallTeamFit: Ahrefs pitches its Standard and Advanced plans at freelance SEOs, marketing consultants and in-house marketing teams rather than non-technical owners, and its Lite plan meters each user's own research activity against a monthly credit allowance that adds a usage concept to track.
reasons.doesTheJob: Ahrefs runs on its own web crawler for backlink and keyword research, technical site audits and rank tracking, and adds a Brand Radar tool for AI-answer brand mentions, all in one subscription.
reasons.freedomToLeave: Lite, Standard and Advanced can be billed monthly and cancelled before renewal, but Ahrefs does not issue refunds in general, offers no option to pause a subscription, and its Enterprise tier requires a minimum one-year commitment.
reasons.trackRecord: Ahrefs has operated since 2010 and states on its own site that it does not run discounts or promotional pricing, so the list price is the price everyone pays.

basis: Ahrefs offers the deepest backlink and keyword research of the three and a no-discount list price, but its plans and messaging are aimed at SEO practitioners rather than non-technical owners, and its no-refund, no-pause policy makes an exit less forgiving.
method: Two independent blind passes scored six factors (1–5) and an overall; published overall is the mean of the two overall scores, rounded down. Pass scores: 3.6 and 3.9.
